memory_update.text: MRVL should remain in the direct custom-AI-silicon bucket, but future layers must separate custom silicon revenue from optics, switching, and generic data-center semiconductor revenue.

SNPS and CDNS are EDA/design-capacity candidates: they may benefit if the AI accelerator bottleneck includes design slots, verification burden, packaging-aware signoff, and advanced-node IP availability.
AMAT is a capacity-enabling equipment candidate across leading-edge foundry, HBM-related memory, and advanced packaging, with evidence strengthened by 2026 NEXX and AI-memory/packaging announcements.
ASX adds OSAT/advanced-packaging exposure to the node; compare its AI package capacity against TSMC internal advanced packaging and other OSATs in later layers.

ONTO was excluded from the capped candidate list but has unusually relevant HBM4 inspection/metrology evidence. It should be considered in the next pass focused on inspection, metrology, yield, and packaging process control.

Additional US-listed equipment and process-control names to test later: KLAC, LRCX, FORM, TER, MKSI, AEIS, COHR, ENTG, ICHR, UCTT, and ACMR. Their inclusion requires ticker-specific evidence of AI accelerator, advanced-node, HBM, or advanced-packaging revenue exposure.

node: AI accelerators, custom ASICs, and advanced foundry capacity
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the node beyond merchant GPU leaders into five chokepoint-adjacent areas: custom AI silicon design, EDA/IP for advanced-node and multi-die AI chips, wafer-fab and advanced-packaging equipment, outsourced advanced packaging, and HBM/advanced-packaging inspection/metrology. These names are research candidates, not recommendations. The strongest evidence in this pass is for Marvell, Synopsys, Cadence, Applied Materials, ASE Technology, and Onto Innovation having direct product or capacity linkage to AI accelerator/custom ASIC/foundry-packaging constraints. Candidate list is capped at five, so Onto is captured in evidence and memory as a follow-up coverage gap rather than a candidate.
